To avoid compression lows with a FreeStyle Libre 2 sensor, choose a placement on your body that won't be compressed by sleep or clothing. Consider using arm bands, elbow pads, or small pillows under your arm for extra support. If you suspect a compression low, verify with a finger stick and allow the reading to correct before treating.
